verdict.rationale: Factory's Droid delegation model lets a developer describe a task in plain language and have it executed via CLI or App with diff review/merge, and Missions supports planning multi-feature work into structured execution — implying natural-language-to-scoped-task conversion. However, there is no explicit evidence of a dedicated 'spec generation' feature that formally scopes/tickets a described feature or bug before implementation, so it's inferred from delegation/orchestration docs rather than directly demonstrated.
